## Combobox.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `options` :: The choices. Options sharing a `group` are listed together under that heading.
- `value` :: The chosen value. Bindable.
- `onValueChange` :: Called with the new value whenever the person chooses or clears it.
- `inputValue` :: The text in the field. Bindable.
- `onInputChange` :: Called whenever the person types, with the new field text — useful for loading options asynchronously.
- `onInputValueChange` :: Called whenever `inputValue` changes, including when a choice fills the field.
- `filter` :: Decides which options match the field text. Defaults to a case-insensitive label match.
- `allowCustom` :: Lets the person commit the typed text as the value, even when it matches no option.
- `loading` :: Shows a loading indicator in the list, for async option loading.
- `empty` :: Content shown when the filter matches nothing and the list is not loading.
- `placeholder` :: The text shown while the field is empty.
- `size` :: The control height. Text follows this unless `textSize` is set. @default 'lg'
- `textSize` :: The text scale, independent of the control height. Follows `size` when omitted.
- `shape` :: The corner shape of the field. @default 'modern'
- `invalid` :: Marks the field as failing validation: a danger border and `aria-invalid`.
- `clearable` :: Shows a button that clears the value and the field.
- `name` :: The name of the hidden input that carries the value in a form submission.
- `open` :: Whether the list is showing. Bindable.
- `onOpenChange` :: Called when the list opens or closes.
- `disabled` :: Blocks typing and opening the list, and dims the field.
- `variant` :: The frame's visual style: `outline` draws the fill and border, while `ghost` and `secondary` drop the border.
- `surface` :: The recipe behind the drop-down: fill, border and shadow together. @default 'glass'
- `childTextSize` :: The scale of the list's quieter text: group headings, descriptions and the empty row. @default 'text-xs'
- `childTextColor` :: The ink of the icons and the list's quieter text. @default 'text-muted'
